breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained two conflicting instructions for the time integration method: 'Explicit forward Euler' and 'Crank–Nicolson'. The ground truth removed the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that only includes 'Use Crank–Nicolson time integration method', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
